name: n8n-mcp
description: MCP server providing AI assistants with comprehensive access to n8n node documentation (1,084 nodes) and workflow management capabilities

n8n_api_url.title: n8n Instance URL
n8n_api_url.description: URL of your n8n instance (e.g., https://your-n8n.com or http://localhost:5678). Leave empty for documentation-only mode.

n8n_api_key.title: n8n API Key
n8n_api_key.description: API key from your n8n instance Settings > API. Required for workflow management features.

n8n_mcp_telemetry_disabled.title: Disable Telemetry
n8n_mcp_telemetry_disabled.description: Set to 'true' to disable telemetry. Leave empty to allow telemetry.

tools.name: tools_documentation
tools.description: Get documentation for n8n MCP tools with quick start guide and topic-specific help

tools.name: search_nodes
tools.description: Search n8n nodes by keyword with optional real-world examples from templates

tools.name: get_node
tools.description: Get node info with progressive detail levels (minimal/standard/full) and multiple modes

tools.name: validate_node
tools.description: Validate n8n node configuration with full or minimal validation modes

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Get workflow template by ID with nodes_only, structure, or full response modes

tools.name: search_templates
tools.description: Search templates by keyword, nodes, task, or metadata filters

tools.name: validate_workflow
tools.description: Full workflow validation: structure, connections, expressions, AI tools

tools.name: n8n_create_workflow
tools.description: Create a new workflow with nodes and connections (created inactive)

tools.name: n8n_get_workflow
tools.description: Get workflow by ID with full, details, structure, or minimal detail levels

tools.name: n8n_update_full_workflow
tools.description: Full workflow update requiring complete nodes and connections

tools.name: n8n_update_partial_workflow
tools.description: Update workflow incrementally with diff operations (add/remove/update nodes)

tools.name: n8n_delete_workflow
tools.description: Permanently delete a workflow (cannot be undone)

tools.name: n8n_list_workflows
tools.description: List workflows with minimal metadata, pagination support

tools.name: n8n_validate_workflow
tools.description: Validate workflow by ID checking nodes, connections, expressions

tools.name: n8n_autofix_workflow
tools.description: Automatically fix common workflow validation errors

tools.name: n8n_test_workflow
tools.description: Test/trigger workflow execution with auto-detected trigger type

tools.name: n8n_executions
tools.description: Manage workflow executions: get details, list, or delete

tools.name: n8n_health_check
tools.description: Check n8n instance health and API connectivity

tools.name: n8n_workflow_versions
tools.description: Manage workflow version history, rollback, and cleanup

tools.name: n8n_deploy_template
tools.description: Deploy a workflow template from n8n.io directly to your instance
